user: How often does Bus_29 violate its limits over the week, and how often does it come close?

grid.name: PGLib IEEE 30-Bus System (Alsac–Stott)
grid.description: Synthetic 7-day profile generated from the bundled PGLib IEEE 30-bus (Alsac–Stott) MATPOWER case: five dispatchable units with their own costs, line ratings from PGLib.

notes: The duration curve sorts the signed margin to the limit per tick (positive = beyond it).
Conditional binning disabled for this request (condition not set).

load_power_factor.applies_to: measured loads (Q = P·tan(acos pf)); the nominal point keeps the case's own Q

assistant:
Over the week (672 15-minute readings), **Bus_29 was outside its voltage limits in 29 readings (4.3%)**. It was **within 0.005 p.u. of a limit without violating in 27 more readings (4.0%)**. All violations were undervoltages below **0.950 p.u.**

The worst reading was **0.932 p.u.** at **19:15 on Jan 6**; the longest listed violation episode ran **18:45–20:45 that day**. Other notable episodes occurred on the evenings of Jan 5 and Jan 7.

📋 Data source: measurements
